senses.gloss: m. h. a ch. (b. h. בַּכֻּרָה; בכר) early, first-ripening, opp. לקיש or אפיל.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 18b:12">Snh. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>אם ב׳ ולקיש וכ׳</he> when the early and the late seeds blossom simultaneously &c.; Y. ib. I, 18ᶜ bot.; Y. R. Hash. I, 58ᵇ bot. (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61:3">Gen. R. s. 61</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:6:1">Koh. R. to XI, 6</cite> (ref. to Koh.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:6:1">ib.</cite>) <he>אם זרעת בב׳</he> if thou hast sown in the early season.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:6:1">Ib.</cite> to VII, 26 <he>לקיש לסטים ב׳ וכ׳</he> (read <he>ללס׳</he>) the latest of the robbers is the first to be hanged.—Fem. h. <he>בַּכִּירָה</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:3:2">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>הב׳ וכ׳</he> the early rain sets in on the third (of Marḥeshvan), v. <cite ref="B00643"><he>בֵּינוֹנִי</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:4:8">Y. Sot. III, 19ᵃ</cite> top <he>תאינה ב׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00771"><he>בִּכּוּרָה</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>בַּכִּירוֹת</he>. Y. Dem. I, beg. 21ᶜ (<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 1:3">Tosef. ib. I, 3</cite> <he>בִּכּוּרוֹת</he>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:1:15">Y. R. Hash. I, 56ᵈ</cite> top <he>אלו הב׳</he> those are the early-bearing sheep; (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:1:3">Y. Shek. III, beg. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>הבכורות</he>, corr. acc.).
